title: Shock Engine BTC/ETH Portfolio
subtitle: BTC-calibrated strategy · applied unchanged to Ethereum
disclaimers: Ethereum parameters were inherited from Bitcoin and were not calibrated on ETH.
Historical simulation after modeled transaction costs. Not live performance.

New positions are only opened in the calm volatility regime, and short entries only when the daily trend regime is bearish. Both conditions were set in October 2026 with knowledge of the 2017–2026 data: the figures are in-sample, not an independent out-of-sample test.
Slippage and perpetual funding are not included in the headline figures.

Execution costs were measured separately on real Binance perpetual-futures trades for every execution since 2020 (institutional dossier); capacity on Hyperliquid, the intended venue, and the strategy’s own market impact are not yet measured.

funding.scenario: historical Binance perpetual funding (2020 onwards; constant +0.01 % per 8 h before 2020)
same, with Hyperliquid funding from May 2023
stress: shorts pay 0.01 % per 8 h at all times

commonPeriod.rule: first UTC day on which both strategies are simulated after warm-up (ETH simulation start) → last complete UTC day covered by both

conventions.returns: daily, UTC close-to-close (equity of the last 15-min bar of each day)
conventions.sharpe: mean / population sd of daily returns × √365.25
conventions.costs: commission 0.045 % per order (each entry and exit fill); slippage 0 as in the validated reference; no funding; no leverage
conventions.sortino: mean / downside deviation of daily returns × √365.25 (target 0: squared negative returns averaged over all days)

allocation.rebalancing: none (official variant A: independent sleeves from a 50/50 start)
diagnostics: B: monthly rebalancing to 50/50 (month-end UTC close)
C (exploratory): inverse 90-day volatility, monthly, weights sum to 1
